author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Several pieces from Adam's collection of spacesuit replicas are on public display at San Francisco's Exploratorium museum! But to prepare these suits for part of the Life in Space exhibition, Adam needs to build custom mannequins to hold up and pose his spacesuits. Here's Adam's philosophy and technique for making spacesuits look great on display. Plus, the shop's clapper board is finally found!

The Exploratorium museum's Life in Space exhibit: https://www.exploratorium.edu/visit/calendar/space

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
